summary: "Deep Down" is a country song written by Walt Aldridge and John Jarrard and recorded by American country artist Pam Tillis. It was released in October 1995 as the first single from her album "All of This Love". The song reached number 6 on Billboard's Hot Country Singles & Tracks chart.
one_line: "Deep Down" is a 1995 country single by Pam Tillis, the first release from her album "All of This Love".
key_facts: "Deep Down" is a song written by Walt Aldridge and John Jarrard.
"Deep Down" was recorded by American country music artist Pam Tillis.
"Deep Down" was the first single from the album "All of This Love".
"Deep Down" reached #6 on the Billboard Hot Country Singles & Tracks chart.
